paragraphs.chinese:
这一集主要讲的是家里的几位父亲努力照顾孩子，虽然他们自己也常常不知道到底该怎么做。

菲尔给卢克买了一辆新自行车，因为他想向克莱尔证明，他们的儿子是能够负起责任的。克莱尔认定卢克很快就会把车弄丢。没过多久，菲尔果然看到一辆很像卢克新车的自行车没有上锁，随便扔在外面。

菲尔决定给卢克一个教训，于是把那辆车拿走藏了起来。可当他帮新邻居德西蕾从窗户爬进锁住的房子时，自行车却不见了。菲尔一下慌了，在克莱尔发现之前赶紧又买了一辆一模一样的车。

回到家后，他才发现卢克真正的自行车一直都在家里。也就是说，他误拿了另一个孩子的车。克莱尔发现这件事后，菲尔不但没有承认全部真相，反而编出了一个更大的故事。不幸的是，德西蕾带着那辆失踪的自行车来到家里，把事情的经过全说了出来。菲尔的谎言当场被拆穿。后来他想把替代品送回去时，又被真正的车主抓了个正着。

与此同时，格洛丽亚让杰和曼尼一起安装吊扇。她希望两个人相处一段时间后，关系能变得更亲近。

事情却进行得很不顺利。杰拒绝看说明书，而曼尼一直在谈自己的亲生父亲哈维尔，说他有多刺激、多勇敢。杰知道哈维尔经常让曼尼失望，所以听得越来越烦。

曼尼被一片风扇叶打中后，两个人吵了起来。曼尼说杰根本不关心他，杰则说自己也不需要当曼尼的父亲。

后来，曼尼在外面等哈维尔，因为哈维尔本来答应要带他去迪士尼乐园。哈维尔打电话给杰，说自己忙着赌博，来不了了。杰气坏了，却不想让曼尼知道真相。

于是，杰告诉曼尼，哈维尔把自己的机票让给了一位老太太，还为曼尼安排了一辆豪华轿车。随后，杰和格洛丽亚亲自带曼尼去了迪士尼。回家的路上，曼尼靠在杰的肩膀上睡着了。

米切尔和卡梅隆也第一次带莉莉去上婴儿课。米切尔担心其他家长会对他们有看法，所以要求卡梅隆穿得低调一点，表现也别那么夸张。

课程开始后，米切尔发现其他孩子的发展好像都比莉莉快，于是越来越紧张。卡梅隆却只想让一家人好好享受这次经历。米切尔最后意识到，自己给所有人都施加了太大压力，于是让卡梅隆做回原来的自己。

到了最后，三个父亲都犯了错。但他们依然在努力，也依然不断花时间陪伴孩子。随着杰一直留在曼尼身边，他关心和保护孩子的那一面，也自然而然地显现了出来。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is mostly about the fathers in the family trying to look after their children, even though they don’t always know what they’re doing.

Phil buys Luke a new bike because he wants to show Claire that their son can be responsible. Claire is sure Luke will lose it, and soon after, Phil sees what looks like Luke’s bike lying outside without a lock.

Phil decides to teach Luke a lesson, so he takes the bike and hides it. But while he’s helping their new neighbor, Desiree, get into her locked house, the bike disappears. Phil panics and buys another one before Claire finds out.

When he gets home, he realizes Luke’s real bike has been there the whole time. He took another child’s bike by mistake. Claire finds out, and instead of admitting everything, Phil makes up an even bigger story. Unfortunately, Desiree arrives with the missing bike and explains exactly what happened. Phil is caught lying, and when he later tries to return the replacement bike, its real owner catches him too.

Meanwhile, Gloria asks Jay and Manny to install a ceiling fan together. She hopes spending some time together will help them get closer.

It doesn’t go well. Jay refuses to read the instructions, while Manny keeps talking about his biological father, Javier, and how exciting and fearless he is. Jay gets annoyed because he knows Javier often lets Manny down.

After Manny gets hit by one of the fan blades, they start arguing. Manny says Jay doesn’t care about him, and Jay says he doesn’t need to be Manny’s father.

Later, Manny waits outside because Javier is supposed to take him to Disneyland. Javier calls Jay and says he isn’t coming because he’s busy gambling. Jay is furious, but he doesn’t want Manny to know the truth.

Instead, Jay tells him that Javier gave his plane ticket to an old woman and arranged a limousine for Manny. Jay and Gloria then take him to Disneyland themselves. On the way home, Manny falls asleep on Jay’s shoulder.

Mitchell and Cameron also take Lily to a baby class for the first time. Mitchell worries that the other parents will judge them, so he asks Cameron to dress and act less dramatically.

Once the class begins, Mitchell becomes nervous because the other babies seem to be developing faster than Lily. Cameron, however, just wants them to enjoy the experience. Mitchell finally realizes that he’s putting too much pressure on everyone and lets Cameron be himself.

By the end, all three fathers have made mistakes. But they keep trying, and they keep spending time with their children. As Jay stays beside Manny, the caring and protective side of him starts to come out naturally.
